headline: Pertamina Fuel Prices Rise: Check Pertalite, Pertamax and Turbo Today, September 6, 2026: Okezone Economy
summary: Pertamina Patra Niaga raised non-subsidised fuel prices on September 1 and 2, 2026. The price of Pertamax Green rose to Rp19,150 per litre.
why: Pertamina is Indonesia's state-owned energy company and the main fuel distributor in the country. Changes to non-subsidised fuel prices affect transport costs, consumer inflation and fuel-retail margins.
